# DDR width refinement captures

The original DDR board TSX ran through tscircuit 0.0.3276, Core 0.0.2457 and autorouter 0.0.1152. Each compressed fixture contains the width solver's normal constructor input, its connectivity map and the routes passed to final width refinement after joint DRC repair. The remaining phase’s original SimpleRouteJson supplies the board boundary and edge clearance. The drawing background contains the native board outline, actual SMT pads and the already-routed byte buses. Each replay draws the remaining traces from its live solver output. [Native board TSX](https://github.com/ShiboSoftwareDev/core-ddr-benchmark/blob/24dc44c166d4258c3538f8b1f66953f1b6f58690/circuits/native-ddr-board.tsx)

- OrangeCrab rev 0.2.1 is a Greg Davill and OrangeCrab FPGA hardware design. The capture uses its DDR3 pads, component positions, routing rules and net declarations. The derived fixture is distributed under CERN-OHL 1.2. [Source KiCad board](https://github.com/orangecrab-fpga/orangecrab-hardware/blob/c511d569fe2af39467041f888bc231020f40c6ac/hardware/orangecrab_r0.2.1/OrangeCrab.kicad_pcb) · [Hardware notice and licenses](../../orangecrab-licenses/NOTICE.txt)
- The Glider mainboard is a Modos Labs hardware design. The capture uses its DDR3 pads, component positions, routing rules and net declarations. The derived fixture is distributed under CERN-OHL-S 2.0.
